displayName: Doctor · Voz en off + Explainer Animado
description: Doctor narra en voz en off (no aparece en pantalla) sobre motion graphics / explainer animado. Para enseñar el mecanismo de un problema/solución de manera didáctica. Estilo Kurzgesagt para salud. Bola en estómago, diagramas de digestión, calendario animado.

category.description: Un especialista habla con autoridad sobre el problema y la solución.

format.description: Motion graphics / explainer animado, doctor solo en voz.

visualStyle.promptTemplate: Bold flat-design 2D motion graphics illustration in explainer-video style, vertical 9:16, medical-educational tone, cream/ivory background with single accent color per scene (cobalt blue for science / coral red for problem / mint green for solution), thick clean outline strokes, geometric anatomical schematics, NO photo-realism, NO faces, NO actors — focus on labeled anatomy diagrams (stomach, esophagus, lymphatic vessels, joints), morphing before/after icons, clean numbers and arrows. Style references: Kurzgesagt, animated medical infographics, In a Nutshell.
visualStyle.negativePrompt: photograph, photo-realistic, 3D render, Pixar, watercolor, oil painting, complex shading, busy detail, actors, faces, talking head, character portraits
